q: 98वें अकादमी पुरस्कार (ऑस्कर 2026) में किस फिल्म ने सर्वश्रेष्ठ फिल्म (Best Picture) का पुरस्कार जीता?
e: *One Battle After Another* won the Best Picture Oscar at the 2026 Academy Awards. | फिल्म 'वन बैटल आफ्टर अनदर' ने ऑस्कर 2026 में सर्वश्रेष्ठ फिल्म का पुरस्कार जीता। Booster Facts: (1) The Academy Awards are presented annually by AMPAS in Los Angeles, USA. (2) India's *RRR* ('Naatu Naatu') and *The Elephant Whisperers* won Oscars in 2023. (3) Bhanu Athaiya was the first Indian to win an Oscar (1983, *Gandhi*).
qe: Which film won the Best Picture award at the 98th Academy Awards (Oscars 2026)?

q:
निम्नलिखित पद्म भूषण 2026 पुरस्कार विजेताओं का उनके क्षेत्रों के साथ सही मिलान कीजिए:
1. विजय अमृतराज — (i) खेल
2. पीयूष पांडे (मरणोपरांत) — (ii) कला (विज्ञापन)
3. शतावधानी आर. गणेश — (iii) कला (संस्कृत अवधान)
सही कूट चुनिए:
e: In the Padma Awards 2026, tennis legend Vijay Amritraj (Sports), advertising icon Piyush Pandey (Posthumous, Art), and scholar-poet Shatavadhani R. Ganesh (Art, Sanskrit Avadhana) were conferred the Padma Bhushan. | पद्म भूषण 2026 में विजय अमृतराज (खेल), पीयूष पांडे (मरणोपरांत, कला) तथा शतावधानी आर. गणेश (कला, संस्कृत अवधान) को सम्मानित किया गया। Booster Facts: (1) Padma Awards were instituted in 1954 and are announced annually on the eve of Republic Day. (2) Padma Vibhushan is India's second-highest civilian honour after Bharat Ratna, followed by Padma Bhushan and Padma Shri. (3) Avadhana is a classical Indian literary feat of spontaneous multi-tasking poetry in Sanskrit/Telugu/Kannada.
qe:
Match the following Padma Bhushan 2026 awardees with their respective fields of distinction:
1. Vijay Amritraj — (i) Sports
2. Piyush Pandey (Posthumous) — (ii) Art (Advertising)
3. Shatavadhani R. Ganesh — (iii) Art (Sanskrit Avadhana)
Select the correct code:

q: अक्टूबर 2026 में रक्षा अधिग्रहण परिषद (DAC) ने लगभग कितने मूल्य के रक्षा खरीद प्रस्तावों को स्वीकृति प्रदान की?
e: In October 2026, the Defence Acquisition Council (DAC), chaired by the Union Defence Minister, accorded Acceptance of Necessity (AoN) to defence procurement proposals worth ₹2.12 lakh crore. | अक्टूबर 2026 में रक्षा अधिग्रहण परिषद (DAC) ने ₹2.12 लाख करोड़ के रक्षा खरीद प्रस्तावों को स्वीकृति दी। Booster Facts: (1) DAC is the highest decision-making body in the Ministry of Defence for capital acquisitions, set up in 2001. (2) Most recent DAC approvals fall under the indigenous 'Buy (Indian-IDDM)' category. (3) UP Defence Industrial Corridor has 6 nodes: Agra, Aligarh, Chitrakoot, Jhansi, Kanpur, and Lucknow.
qe: In October 2026, the Defence Acquisition Council (DAC) approved defence procurement proposals worth approximately how much?

q: अक्टूबर 2026 में किस भारतीय राज्य ने अभिनव 3D-प्रिंटेड ग्रामीण आवास पहल का शुभारंभ किया?
e: Andhra Pradesh launched the 3D-Printed Rural Housing initiative in October 2026 to deliver fast, resilient, low-cost homes in rural areas. | आंध्र प्रदेश ने अक्टूबर 2026 में त्वरित व टिकाऊ ग्रामीण आवास निर्माण हेतु 3D-प्रिंटेड ग्रामीण आवास पहल प्रारंभ की। Booster Facts: (1) 3D concrete printing reduces construction time and material wastage significantly. (2) India's first 3D-printed post office was built in Bengaluru (2023). (3) Amaravati is the capital of Andhra Pradesh.
qe: In October 2026, which Indian state launched a pioneering 3D-Printed Rural Housing initiative?

q: अक्टूबर 2026 में प्रधानमंत्री आवास योजना – शहरी (PMAY-U) 2.0 के अंतर्गत लगभग कितने नए आवासों को स्वीकृति दी गई?
e: Over 1.93 lakh new houses were approved under PMAY-Urban 2.0 in October 2026 to support urban EWS, LIG, and MIG beneficiaries. | अक्टूबर 2026 में PMAY-शहरी 2.0 के अंतर्गत 1.93 लाख से अधिक नए आवासों को मंजूरी दी गई। Booster Facts: (1) PMAY-Urban 2.0 is implemented by the Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs (MoHUA). (2) Its four verticals are BLC (Beneficiary-Led Construction), AHP (Affordable Housing in Partnership), ARH (Affordable Rental Housing), and ISS (Interest Subsidy Scheme). (3) PMAY-U 2.0 targets 1 crore urban families over five years.
qe: Under the Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana – Urban (PMAY-U) 2.0 in October 2026, approximately how many new houses were approved?

q: अक्टूबर 2026 में भारतीय नौसेना ने कंबाइंड टास्क फोर्स 154 (CTF-154) का अपना पहला कमान कार्यकाल पूरा किया। कंबाइंड मैरीटाइम फोर्सेज (CMF) के अंतर्गत CTF-154 का मुख्य दायित्व क्या है?
o: गहरे समुद्र में खनिज खनन विनियमन
मध्य पूर्व में समुद्री सुरक्षा प्रशिक्षण
e: CTF-154, established in May 2023 under the Bahrain-headquartered Combined Maritime Forces (CMF), is dedicated to Maritime Security Training across the Middle East and Indian Ocean region; the Indian Navy completed its first command tenure in October 2026. | CTF-154 (बहरीन स्थित CMF के अधीन) मध्य पूर्व क्षेत्र में समुद्री सुरक्षा प्रशिक्षण पर केंद्रित है; भारतीय नौसेना ने अक्टूबर 2026 में इसकी पहली कमान पूरी की। Booster Facts: (1) CMF is a multinational naval partnership of over 45 nations. (2) Other CMF task forces include CTF-150 (maritime security outside Gulf), CTF-151 (counter-piracy), and CTF-153 (Red Sea). (3) Indian Navy Day is observed annually on 4 December.
qe: In October 2026, the Indian Navy completed its maiden command tenure of Combined Task Force 154 (CTF-154). What is the primary mandate of CTF-154 under the Combined Maritime Forces (CMF)?
oe: Maritime security training across the Middle East

q: उत्तर प्रदेश का कौन-सा नगर 'संगम नगरी' के नाम से प्रसिद्ध है जहाँ गंगा, यमुना और अदृश्य सरस्वती का त्रिवेणी संगम है?
e: Prayagraj hosts the sacred Triveni Sangam and is the venue for Maha Kumbh (every 12 years), Ardh Kumbh, and annual Magh Mela. | प्रयागराज में गंगा, यमुना व सरस्वती का त्रिवेणी संगम स्थित है, जहाँ महाकुंभ व माघ मेला लगता है। Booster Facts: (1) Prayagraj is UP's most populous district (Census 2011). (2) Allahabad High Court (1866) and UPPSC headquarters are located in Prayagraj. (3) Anand Bhavan and Chandrashekhar Azad Park are historic landmarks of Prayagraj.
qe: Which city of Uttar Pradesh is famously known as 'Sangam Nagari' and hosts the Triveni Sangam of Ganga, Yamuna, and mythical Saraswati?

q: उत्तर प्रदेश का राजकीय पुष्प निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा है?
e: Palash (Butea monosperma, also called Tesu or Flame of the Forest) was adopted as the state flower of Uttar Pradesh in 2011. | पलाश (टेसू) उत्तर प्रदेश का राजकीय पुष्प है। Booster Facts: (1) State animal: Barasingha (Swamp Deer). (2) State bird: Sarus Crane (सारस क्रेन). (3) State tree: Ashoka (अशोक); State sport: Field Hockey.
qe: Which is the state flower of Uttar Pradesh?

q: उत्तर प्रदेश का कौन-सा शहर ODOP योजना के अंतर्गत अपनी पारंपरिक चिकनकारी कढ़ाई के लिए प्रसिद्ध है?
e: Lucknow's official ODOP product is Chikankari and Zari-Zardozi, a GI-tagged heritage embroidery craft patronized since the Nawabi era. | लखनऊ का आधिकारिक ODOP उत्पाद चिकनकारी एवं ज़री-ज़रदोजी है। Booster Facts: (1) Bara Imambara (built by Nawab Asaf-ud-Daula in 1784) and Rumi Darwaza are iconic monuments of Lucknow. (2) Lucknow lies on the banks of the Gomti River. (3) Central Drug Research Institute (CDRI) and NBRI are located in Lucknow.
qe: Which city in Uttar Pradesh is renowned for its traditional Chikankari embroidery under the ODOP scheme?

q: उत्तर प्रदेश के प्रथम मुख्यमंत्री कौन थे?
e: Pandit Govind Ballabh Pant served as the first Chief Minister of Uttar Pradesh (1950–1954) and later became Union Home Minister (awarded Bharat Ratna in 1957). | पं. गोविंद बल्लभ पंत उत्तर प्रदेश के प्रथम मुख्यमंत्री थे (1957 में भारत रत्न से सम्मानित)। Booster Facts: (1) Sucheta Kripalani was the first woman Chief Minister of UP and India (1963–67). (2) Sarojini Naidu was the first Governor of UP. (3) Chaudhary Charan Singh served as both UP CM and Prime Minister of India.
qe: Who was the first Chief Minister of Uttar Pradesh?

q: उत्तर प्रदेश की निम्नलिखित नदियों और उनके तट पर बसे नगरों में से कौन-सा युग्म सही सुमेलित नहीं है?
e: Varanasi is situated on the left bank of the Ganga River, whereas the Betwa flows through Bundelkhand (Jhansi, Hamirpur, Orchha). | वाराणसी गंगा नदी के तट पर स्थित है, जबकि बेतवा बुंदेलखंड (झाँसी, हमीरपुर) से होकर बहती है। Booster Facts: (1) Lucknow, Sultanpur, and Jaunpur lie on the Gomti River. (2) Agra, Mathura, and Etawah lie on the Yamuna River. (3) Kanpur, Kannauj, Prayagraj, Mirzapur, and Ghazipur lie on the Ganga River.
qe: Which of the following pairs of Uttar Pradesh rivers and cities situated on their banks is NOT correctly matched?

q: प्लासी का युद्ध किस वर्ष लड़ा गया था, जिससे बंगाल में ब्रिटिश राजनीतिक प्रभुत्व की शुरुआत हुई?
e: The Battle of Plassey was fought on 23 June 1757 between Robert Clive (East India Company) and Nawab Siraj-ud-Daulah of Bengal. | प्लासी का युद्ध 23 जून 1757 को रॉबर्ट क्लाइव और बंगाल के नवाब सिराजुद्दौला के बीच लड़ा गया था। Booster Facts: (1) The Third Battle of Panipat was fought in 1761 (Ahmad Shah Abdali vs Marathas). (2) The Battle of Buxar was fought in 1764 (Hector Munro vs Mir Qasim, Shuja-ud-Daulah, Shah Alam II). (3) The Treaty of Allahabad (1765) granted Diwani rights of Bengal, Bihar, and Orissa to the EIC.
qe: In which year was the Battle of Plassey fought, marking the beginning of British political supremacy in Bengal?

q: प्रसिद्ध संस्कृत नाटक 'अभिज्ञानशाकुन्तलम्' और महाकाव्य 'रघुवंशम्' की रचना किसने की थी?
e: Mahakavi Kalidasa, one of the Navaratnas in Chandragupta II's court, authored Abhijnanashakuntalam, Meghadutam, Kumarasambhavam, and Raghuvamsham. | महाकवि कालिदास (चंद्रगुप्त द्वितीय के नवरत्नों में से एक) ने अभिज्ञानशाकुन्तलम् व रघुवंशम् की रचना की। Booster Facts: (1) Bhavabhuti authored Uttararamacharitam and Malatimadhava. (2) Shudraka wrote Mrichchhakatika. (3) Vishakhadatta authored Mudrarakshasa.
qe: Who composed the famous Sanskrit play 'Abhijnanashakuntalam' and epic 'Raghuvamsham'?

q: बंगाल, बिहार और उड़ीसा में 1793 में भू-राजस्व की 'स्थायी बंदोबस्त' (जमींदारी प्रणाली) किसके द्वारा लागू की गई थी?
e: Lord Cornwallis introduced the Permanent Settlement in 1793 based on John Shore's plan, fixing land revenue permanently with zamindars. | लॉर्ड कॉर्नवालिस ने 1793 में जॉन शोर की योजना पर स्थायी बंदोबस्त लागू किया। Booster Facts: (1) Ryotwari System was introduced by Thomas Munro and Alexander Read in Madras/Bombay. (2) Mahalwari System was introduced by Holt Mackenzie (1822) in North-Western Provinces (including UP). (3) Lord Cornwallis is also known as the 'Father of Civil Services in India'.
qe: The 'Permanent Settlement' (Zamindari System) of land revenue was introduced in Bengal, Bihar, and Orissa in 1793 by:

q: जातिगत भेदभाव के विरुद्ध 1873 में महाराष्ट्र में 'सत्यशोधक समाज' की स्थापना किसने की थी?
e: Mahatma Jyotirao Phule founded Satyashodhak Samaj in Pune on 24 September 1873 and authored the famous book *Gulamgiri*. | महात्मा ज्योतिराव फुले ने 24 सितंबर 1873 को पुणे में सत्यशोधक समाज की स्थापना की और 'गुलामगिरी' पुस्तक लिखी। Booster Facts: (1) Savitribai Phule is celebrated as India's first female teacher (opened India's first girls' school in Pune in 1848). (2) Dr. B. R. Ambedkar founded Bahishkrit Hitakarini Sabha (1924). (3) Narayana Guru led the Vaikom/SNDP social reform movement in Kerala.
qe: Who founded the 'Satyashodhak Samaj' (Truth-Seekers' Society) in Maharashtra in 1873 to fight caste discrimination?

q:
सिंधु घाटी सभ्यता (हड़प्पा संस्कृति) के संबंध में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार कीजिए:
कथन I: गुजरात के लोथल में गोदीवाड़ा (dockyard) के अवशेष प्राप्त हुए हैं।
कथन II: राजस्थान के कालीबंगा में जुते हुए खेत के साक्ष्य उत्खनन में मिले हैं।
उपर्युक्त कथनों में से कौन-सा/से सही है/हैं?
o: न तो कथन I और न ही II
e: Both statements are correct. Lothal (on Bhogava river, Gujarat) had a brick-built dockyard, while Kalibangan (on Ghaggar river, Rajasthan) yielded ploughed field furrows and fire altars. | दोनों कथन सही हैं। लोथल (गुजरात) में गोदीवाड़ा तथा कालीबंगा (राजस्थान) में जुते हुए खेत के साक्ष्य मिले हैं। Booster Facts: (1) Dholavira (Gujarat, UNESCO World Heritage Site 2021) is famous for advanced water reservoirs and three-tier town planning. (2) Rakhigarhi (Haryana) is the largest Harappan site in India. (3) The bronze 'Dancing Girl' and 'Great Bath' were excavated at Mohenjo-daro.
qe:
Consider the following statements regarding the Indus Valley Civilization (Harappan Culture):
Statement I: Dockyard remains have been discovered at Lothal in Gujarat.
Statement II: Evidence of a ploughed field (जुता हुआ खेत) has been excavated at Kalibangan in Rajasthan.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?

q: भारत के संविधान का कौन-सा अनुच्छेद 'अस्पृश्यता' का अंत करता है और किसी भी रूप में इसके आचरण का निषेध करता है?
e: Article 17 abolishes untouchability and makes its enforcement an offence punishable by law (Protection of Civil Rights Act, 1955). | अनुच्छेद 17 अस्पृश्यता का अंत करता है और इसके आचरण को दंडनीय अपराध घोषित करता है। Booster Facts: (1) Article 14 guarantees Equality before Law; Article 15 prohibits discrimination on religion, race, caste, sex, or place of birth. (2) Article 18 abolishes titles (except military and academic distinctions). (3) Article 32 (Right to Constitutional Remedies) was called the 'heart and soul of the Constitution' by Dr. B. R. Ambedkar.
qe: Which Article of the Constitution of India abolishes 'Untouchability' and forbids its practice in any form?

q: भारत के संविधान का कौन-सा अनुच्छेद धार्मिक और भाषाई अल्पसंख्यकों को अपनी रुचि की शिक्षण संस्थाओं की स्थापना और प्रशासन का अधिकार देता है?
e: Article 30(1) grants all minorities (based on religion or language) the right to establish and administer educational institutions of their choice. | अनुच्छेद 30(1) धार्मिक एवं भाषाई अल्पसंख्यकों को अपनी पसंद के शिक्षण संस्थान स्थापित व संचालित करने का अधिकार देता है। Booster Facts: (1) Article 28 prohibits religious instruction in educational institutions wholly maintained out of State funds. (2) Article 29 protects the distinct language, script, or culture of any section of citizens. (3) Article 46 directs the State to promote educational and economic interests of SCs, STs, and weaker sections.
qe: Which Article of the Constitution of India grants religious and linguistic minorities the right to establish and administer educational institutions of their choice?

q: राष्ट्रीय अध्यापक शिक्षा परिषद (NCTE) को संसद के एक अधिनियम द्वारा वैधानिक दर्जा किस वर्ष प्रदान किया गया?
e: NCTE became a statutory body under the National Council for Teacher Education Act, 1993 (and formally came into existence as a statutory body on 17 August 1995) to regulate teacher education standards. | राष्ट्रीय अध्यापक शिक्षा परिषद अधिनियम, 1993 द्वारा NCTE को वैधानिक दर्जा प्राप्त हुआ (17 अगस्त 1995 से प्रभावी)। Booster Facts: (1) UGC became a statutory body under the UGC Act, 1956. (2) NCERT was established in 1961 as an autonomous society (headquarters: New Delhi). (3) AICTE received statutory status in 1987.
qe: The National Council for Teacher Education (NCTE) was accorded statutory status as a national regulatory body by an Act of Parliament passed in which year?

q: किस संविधान संशोधन अधिनियम द्वारा भाग IX और 11वीं अनुसूची जोड़कर पंचायती राज संस्थाओं को संवैधानिक दर्जा प्रदान किया गया?
e: The 73rd Constitutional Amendment Act, 1992 (effective 24 April 1993) added Part IX (Articles 243–243O) and the 11th Schedule (29 subjects) for Panchayati Raj. | 73वें संविधान संशोधन अधिनियम, 1992 (24 अप्रैल 1993 से प्रभावी) ने भाग IX व 11वीं अनुसूची (29 विषय) जोड़कर पंचायती राज को संवैधानिक दर्जा दिया। Booster Facts: (1) National Panchayati Raj Day is celebrated on 24 April. (2) The 74th Amendment Act, 1992 added Part IXA and the 12th Schedule (18 subjects) for Urban Local Bodies. (3) Balwant Rai Mehta Committee (1957) recommended the three-tier Panchayati Raj structure.
qe: Which Constitutional Amendment Act granted constitutional status to Panchayati Raj Institutions by inserting Part IX and the 11th Schedule?

q: उच्चतम न्यायालय या उच्च न्यायालयों द्वारा जारी निम्नलिखित में से किस रिट का शाब्दिक अर्थ 'किस अधिकार से' है और जिसका प्रयोग किसी सार्वजनिक पद पर व्यक्ति के दावे की वैधता को चुनौती देने हेतु किया जाता है?
e: Quo Warranto ('by what authority or warrant') enquires into the legality of a person holding a substantive public office. | 'अधिकार पृच्छा' (Quo Warranto) का अर्थ है 'किस अधिकार से', जो किसी लोक पद पर अनाधिकृत दावे की जाँच हेतु जारी की जाती है। Booster Facts: (1) Habeas Corpus ('to have the body of') protects against illegal detention. (2) Mandamus ('we command') directs a public official to perform a statutory duty. (3) Prohibition and Certiorari are issued against judicial/quasi-judicial bodies.
qe: Which of the following writs issued by the Supreme Court or High Courts literally means 'by what authority' and is used to challenge the legality of a person's claim to a public office?

q: पूर्णतः भारत (निर्विवाद क्षेत्र) में स्थित हिमालय की सबसे ऊँची पर्वत चोटी कौन-सी है?
e: Nanda Devi (7,816 m, Uttarakhand) is the highest peak located entirely within undisputed Indian territory; Kanchenjunga (8,586 m) lies on the India–Nepal border, and K2 (8,611 m) is in PoK. | नंदा देवी (7,816 मी, उत्तराखंड) पूर्णतः भारत में स्थित सर्वोच्च चोटी है; कंचनजंगा भारत-नेपाल सीमा पर है। Booster Facts: (1) Anamudi (2,695 m, Kerala) is the highest peak of the Western Ghats and Peninsular India. (2) Guru Shikhar (1,722 m, Mount Abu) is the highest peak of the Aravalli Range. (3) Dhupgarh (1,350 m) is the highest peak of the Satpura Range.
qe: Which is the highest mountain peak located entirely within India (undisputed) in the Himalayas?

q: भारत में सर्वाधिक भौगोलिक क्षेत्रफल पर किस प्रकार की मृदा पाई जाती है जो गेहूँ, धान और गन्ने की खेती के लिए सर्वाधिक उपजाऊ है?
e: Alluvial soil covers over 40% of India's total land area (especially the Indo-Gangetic-Brahmaputra plains) and is rich in potash though generally deficient in nitrogen. | जलोढ़ मृदा भारत के 40% से अधिक क्षेत्रफल पर फैली है और कृषि हेतु सर्वाधिक उपजाऊ है। Booster Facts: (1) Older alluvium is called 'Bhangar' and newer fertile flood-plain alluvium is called 'Khadar'. (2) Black (Regur) soil of the Deccan Plateau is ideal for cotton and is self-ploughing. (3) Laterite soil is formed by intense leaching under high rainfall and is suited for cashew/tea/coffee.
qe: Which type of soil covers the largest geographical area in India and is most fertile for wheat, rice, and sugarcane cultivation?

q: जनगणना 2011 के अनुसार, 2001–2011 के दौरान भारत के किस राज्य में ऋणात्मक (negative) दशकीय जनसंख्या वृद्धि दर दर्ज की गई?
e: Nagaland was the only Indian state to record a negative decadal population growth rate (−0.58%) in Census 2011, whereas Meghalaya recorded the highest (+27.95%). | जनगणना 2011 में नागालैंड (−0.58%) ऋणात्मक दशकीय जनसंख्या वृद्धि दर दर्ज करने वाला भारत का एकमात्र राज्य था। Booster Facts: (1) India's overall decadal growth rate (2001–2011) was 17.7%. (2) The year 1921 is called the 'Year of Great Divide' in Indian demographic history (the only census showing negative national growth). (3) Census is conducted under the Census Act, 1948 by the Office of the Registrar General and Census Commissioner (Ministry of Home Affairs).
qe: According to Census 2011, which Indian state recorded a NEGATIVE decadal population growth rate during 2001–2011?

q: भारत के सकल घरेलू उत्पाद (GDP) में किस क्षेत्रक का योगदान सर्वाधिक है?
e: The Services (Tertiary) sector contributes over 54% of India's Gross Value Added (GVA)/GDP, led by IT, finance, trade, transport, and public administration. | सेवा (तृतीयक) क्षेत्रक भारत की GDP/GVA में 54% से अधिक का सर्वाधिक योगदान देता है। Booster Facts: (1) Agriculture (Primary sector) still employs the largest share of India's workforce (~45%). (2) The National Statistical Office (NSO) under MoSPI estimates India's GDP. (3) Base year for current GDP series has been 2011–12.
qe: Which sector contributes the largest share to India's Gross Domestic Product (GDP)?

q: अर्थशास्त्र में 'स्टैगफ्लेशन' (Stagflation) किस सहवर्ती स्थिति को दर्शाता है?
o: आर्थिक स्थिरता (उच्च बेरोजगारी) और उच्च मुद्रास्फीति
e: Stagflation combines stagnant economic growth (high unemployment) with persistently high inflation, posing a severe dilemma for policymakers. | स्टैगफ्लेशन में आर्थिक मंदी/उच्च बेरोजगारी के साथ-साथ उच्च मुद्रास्फीति एक साथ विद्यमान होती है। Booster Facts: (1) The Phillips Curve normally depicts an inverse relationship between inflation and unemployment in the short run. (2) Disinflation means a slowdown in the rate of inflation; Deflation means a general fall in price levels (negative inflation). (3) Core inflation excludes volatile food and fuel prices.
qe: In economics, 'Stagflation' refers to a simultaneous situation of:
oe: Economic stagnation (high unemployment) and high inflation

q: भारत में निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा कर एक प्रत्यक्ष कर (Direct Tax) है?
e: Securities Transaction Tax (STT), Income Tax, and Corporate Tax are direct taxes administered by CBDT, whereas GST, Customs Duty, and Excise Duty are indirect taxes administered by CBIC. | प्रतिभूति लेन-देन कर (STT), आयकर व निगम कर प्रत्यक्ष कर हैं (CBDT द्वारा प्रशासित), जबकि GST, सीमा शुल्क व उत्पाद शुल्क अप्रत्यक्ष कर हैं। Booster Facts: (1) In a direct tax, the impact and incidence of tax fall on the same person. (2) Income tax in India is progressive in nature. (3) Finance Bill is introduced annually along with the Union Budget under Article 112 (Annual Financial Statement).
qe: Which of the following taxes in India is a DIRECT tax?

q: मानव मस्तिष्क का कौन-सा भाग मुख्य रूप से शरीर की मुद्रा और संतुलन बनाए रखने के लिए उत्तरदायी है?
e: The cerebellum (hindbrain) coordinates voluntary muscular movements, posture, and equilibrium. | अनुमस्तिष्क (Cerebellum) ऐच्छिक पेशीय गतियों, शरीर की मुद्रा और संतुलन को नियंत्रित करता है। Booster Facts: (1) Cerebrum controls intelligence, memory, and reasoning. (2) Medulla oblongata controls involuntary actions like heartbeat, breathing, and swallowing. (3) Hypothalamus regulates body temperature, hunger, thirst, and the pituitary gland.
qe: Which part of the human brain is primarily responsible for maintaining body posture and balance?

q: कंप्यूटर नेटवर्क और ICT में प्रोटोकॉल संक्षिप्त नाम 'HTTPS' का पूर्ण रूप क्या है?
e: HTTPS stands for Hypertext Transfer Protocol Secure; it encrypts web communications using TLS/SSL to ensure confidentiality and integrity. | HTTPS का पूर्ण रूप Hypertext Transfer Protocol Secure है, जो TLS/SSL एन्क्रिप्शन द्वारा सुरक्षित वेब संचार सुनिश्चित करता है। Booster Facts: (1) Default port for HTTP is 80 and for HTTPS is 443. (2) URL stands for Uniform Resource Locator and DNS for Domain Name System. (3) Phishing is a cyberattack using deceptive emails/websites to steal credentials.
qe: In computer networks and ICT, what does the protocol acronym 'HTTPS' stand for?

q:
विद्युत-चुंबकीय तरंगों और प्रकाश के संबंध में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार कीजिए:
कथन I: एक्स-रे (X-rays) की तरंगदैर्ध्य दृश्य प्रकाश से कम तथा आवृत्ति अधिक होती है।
कथन II: ध्वनि तरंगें अनुप्रस्थ विद्युत-चुंबकीय तरंगें हैं जो निर्वात में भी गमन कर सकती हैं।
उपर्युक्त कथनों में से कौन-सा/से सही है/हैं?
o: न तो कथन I और न ही II
e: Statement I is correct (X-rays have higher energy/frequency and shorter wavelength than visible light). Statement II is incorrect because sound waves are longitudinal mechanical waves requiring a material medium and cannot travel through vacuum. | कथन I सही है। कथन II गलत है क्योंकि ध्वनि तरंगें अनुदैर्ध्य यांत्रिक तरंगें हैं जिन्हें माध्यम चाहिए और वे निर्वात में नहीं चल सकतीं। Booster Facts: (1) W. C. Röntgen discovered X-rays in 1895 (first Physics Nobel Prize, 1901). (2) Speed of light in vacuum is 3 × 10⁸ m/s; speed of sound in air at 20°C is ~343 m/s. (3) Audible frequency range for humans is 20 Hz to 20,000 Hz.
qe:
Consider the following statements about electromagnetic waves and light:
Statement I: X-rays have shorter wavelengths and higher frequencies than visible light.
Statement II: Sound waves are transverse electromagnetic waves that can travel through vacuum.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
